name: Can a walk-in shower be installed in a small or narrow bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can a walk-in shower be installed in a small or narrow bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, professional contractors can install walk-in showers in smaller bathrooms by optimizing the layout and selecting the right enclosure style. Replacing an existing 60-inch tub alcove with a walk-in shower is one of the most common space-efficient upgrades. In compact spaces, sliding bypass glass doors, single fixed glass splash panels, or open walk-in configurations avoid the clearance issues of swinging hinged doors. Integrating recessed wall niches also adds shampoo and soap storage directly inside wall cavities, keeping the shower footprint open and uncluttered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Replacing a standard tub alcove with a walk-in shower using sliding glass, fixed panels, and recessed wall niches maximizes usable space in small bathrooms.
